exposure: fetal head station (assessed by digital vaginal examination, head perineal distance, and angle of progression)
cohort: 600 primiparous women in active first stage of labor
finding: Intrapartum ultrasound measurements of head perineal distance (HPD) and angle of progression (AOP) are more informative for predicting labor progress and mode of delivery than digital vaginal examination.
mod_finding: The combined use of HPD and AOP had a high sensitivity (97.7%) and positive predictive value (86.63%) for predicting mode of delivery.
